## Release v0.7.3

Compare changes: https://github.com/JosXa/opencode-pty/compare/v0.7.2...v0.7.3

- chore: bump version to v0.7.3 (c159a39)
- fix: preserve subagents on quick PTY exit (0066953)
- docs: propose pty wakeup tool (81c6139)
- fix: rename snapshot wait stability option (e2e273f)
- fix: handle pty slash commands without throwing (67e3912)
- fix: suppress duplicate pty exit notifications (a840e61)

### Installation

Add to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["@josxa/opencode-pty"]
}
```

### Update Instructions

To get the latest version:

```bash
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/packages/@josxa+opencode-pty*
opencode
```
